turns.content: Mere parents ne is Sunday ek "meeting" fix kar di hai. Hamari community ki family hai, ladka Dallas mein kaam karta hai, meri photo already share ho chuki hai apparently. Jo unhe nahi pata — main do saal se ek relationship mein hoon, colleague hai mera. Bahut achha hai woh. Bas alag caste ka hai, aur mere ghar mein woh word aate hi baat khatam ho jaati hai. Mere paas paanch din hain.

Arre, ye toh bahut bada pressure hai. Paanch din bahut kam waqt hai is sab handle karne ke liye, aur main samajh sakti hoon kitna pareshaan honge aap right now.

Ek taraf aapka 2 saal ka relationship hai jisme aap khush hain, aur doosri taraf family ki expectations aur us 'caste' wali dabangai. Ye double bind bilkul fair nahi hai.

Sunday ki meeting ke liye aapka plan kya hai? Kya aap soch rahe hain ki usse milke baat khatam kar denge, ya aapko lag raha hai ki parents ko sach bolne ka waqt aa gaya hai? Kyunki agar aap us meeting se bach jaate hain bhi, toh aapka relationship waise bhi 'hidden' toh nahi reh sakta hain na.

Bataiye, man kya kar raha hai abhi?

Last month maine hint karne ki koshish ki thi ki main ready nahi hoon, aur usi shaam Amma ka BP badh gaya — ya kam se kam sabne mujhe yahi bola. Appa ne mama ki family ko Sunday ke baare mein bata bhi diya hai. Baat Dallas wale ladke ki hai bhi nahi — woh log bure nahi hain, yahi sabse bura part hai. Woh excited hain. Unko lagta hai woh meri care kar rahe hain.

Ye BP ka emotional blackmail sabse bada weapon hota hai parents ke paas. Aapko apni zarurat se zyada unke health ke liye responsible mehsus karwa diya gaya hai, jisse aap apna point rakhna hi bhool jaate hain.

Dusri taraf, jab ladke-wale acche aur excited hote hain, toh situation aur bhi guilt-trip wali ho jaati hai. Aapko lag raha hoga ki aap unka waast barbaad kar rahe hain, jabki asli mehmaan toh aap hi hain apni zindagi mein. Appa ne mama ko bata diya matlab ab ye sirf aapki life ka faisla nahi, ab "family ki izzat" bhi jud gayi hai. Aap beech mein phas gaye hain.

Lekin sawal yeh hai ki aap in 5 dino mein kya chahte hain? Kya aap Sunday ko milke unhe politely reject karna chahte hain, ya aapko lagta hai ki agar aapne sach nahi bola toh aap apne boyfriend ke saath bhi unfair honge? Aapke partner ko is sab ke baare mein pata hai? Unhone kya keha hai aapne?

Online jo bhi padhti hoon sab yahi bolte hain — "you're 27, it's your life, clearly bol do: my life, my choice." Mann kar raha hai aaj dinner pe seedha yahi bol doon aur Sunday se pehle yeh poora circus band karwa doon. Bol doon? Kam se kam sab kuch bahar toh aa jayega.

Bolne ka mann bahut strong lag raha hai, kyunki aapke andar jitna darr aur guilt ka bojh hai, wo bahar hi aana chahiye. Par online log jab ye bolte hain, wo unke liye asaan hai kyunki unke ghar mein Amma ka BP aur Appa ki family politics nahi hoti.

Agar aap aaj dinner pe seedha "my life, my choice" bolkar phenk denge, toh sach mein sab bahar aa jayega—par shayad uske saath bahut bada hungaama bhi. Aapko taiyar rehna padega ki kal subah situation kaafi badi ho sakti hai. Amma ka health card phir se khinch liya jayega.

Lekin ek baat sochiye—agar aap aaj chup rahengi, toh Sunday ko us ladke ke aate waqt aapka guilt aur double hi badh jayega. Woh toh bechara apni family ke saath excited aa raha hoga, use bhi toh insaniyat ka haq hai ki usko aapke "no" ka jawab jaldi mil jaye, na ki ki aap apne family ke dabav mein majboor ho.

Aapko lagta hai ki aap dinner pe itni calm rah sakti hain ki apni baat samjha sakein, ya gussa aap pe haavi ho jayega?

Aur agar end mein woh na bole — matlab final, pakka na — toh sach mein mujhse unke against ghar chhod ke nikla nahi jayega. Maine imagine karke dekha hai, nahi hota mujhse. Kya main weak hoon? Kabhi lagta hai main usse utna pyaar nahi karti, phir lagta hai main khud se pyaar nahi karti, aur raat ke do baje bas yahi circles chal rahe hain.

Aap weak bilkul nahi hain. Please, apne aap ko itha bada mat dijiye.

Ghar chhod ke nikalna—woh bhi aise hi, ek pal mein—ek bahut bada, bahut scary step hai. Uske liye zaroori nahi ki aap physically weak hon, par emotional safety net toot jana bahut dard hota hai. Aap unse pyaar karte hain, unka sath chahte hain, aur ye darr ki agar aapne apni baat rakhi toh woh rishta toot jayega—ye darr natural hai. Isi ka naam attachment kehte hain, weakness nahi.

Aur do baje ki yeh sochein—"main usse pyaar nahi karti" ya "main khud se pyaar nahi karti"—ye sab stress ki wajah se aarahi hain. Aap beech mein phas gayi hain. Ek taraf aapka partner hai jiske saath aapne future dekha hai, doosri taraf woh log jinhone aapko palaya hai. Dono taraf darr lag raha hai khona.

Agar aapke paas ghar chalne ka plan nahi hai, na hi financial backup hai, toh "final, pakka no" bolke ghar mein jungle lagana samajhdaari nahi hogi. Kyunki uske baad bhi aap wahi wahin rahengi, toh environment kitna toxic ho jayega soch sakti hain?

Aapki priority kya hai abhi—Sunday ki meeting rukwana hai, ya apne relationship ke baare mein sach bolna? Agar ghar nahi chhod sakti, toh kya aap "not ready right now" bolke situation ko handle kar sakti hain bina "caste" aur "boyfriend" ka khada kiye?
